verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships versioned releases with dated per-version changelogs (v1.6.0 through v1.19.0) that match its GitHub releases, which covers the 'versioned releases with changelogs' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents migration notes, upgrade procedures, or a repair or rollback path when an update breaks. missing for 10: migration/upgrade notes, documented rollback or repair path, backward-compatibility or deprecation policy, hands-on corroboration that updates are safe.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks
